gerard_established_by: Title: 'opera I'. The 'libro N di quartetti' series is Boccherini's own numbering and is corroborated by RISM records that carry GerB numbers: libro primo=990005852 (G159), secondo=990005861 (G165-170), terzo=990005866 (G171), quarto=VMA-3887(4) which cites Gerard 177 itself, quinto=990005874 (G183).
rism_related_established_by: This copy is not in RISM -- it was found on a library portal. These are RISM's records for the same print of the same works (GerB 159, 160, 161, 162, 163, 164), matched on the Gérard set. They describe the edition, not this copy.
